test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**produced**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the first blank is '**produced**'.
 
• The given passage is about the **creation of superheroes in Indian comics**. It mentions various **characters** and publishers who have contributed to the Indian comic book industry.
 
• **Sentence 1 **refers to the creation of superheroes in comics. The word "**produced**" fits well in this context, as it means to create, manufacture, or bring into existence.
 
• The other options do not fit as well with the context of the sentence.
 
• "**Built**" is more commonly used to refer to the physical construction of something, such as a building or structure.
 
• "**Fabricated**" and "**manufactured**" also have more of a connotation of physical production, rather than the creation of fictional characters in a medium such as comic books.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct *Passage*:__** *Comics have **(1) **__**p**roduced__ many superheroes. Bantul, the great was (2) ________ in the year 1965 in the backdrop of the Indo-Pak war. Indrajal comics was set up in 1964 and (3) __________ Aabid Surti, who gave birth to a character called Bhadur in 1976 wearing kurta and jeans. Raj comics too (4) ________ into this sphere with their (5) ________ toons Nagraj, Tiranga and Shakti together called Brahman Rakshak (protectors of the universe).*
